name: KitchenConversationsEveningChat_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an end-of-day kitchen conversation between a couple unwinding while one cooks. One is a storyteller; the other cooks and listens. Threads get started and lost. No virtual assistant involved.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Evening kitchen ambience, soft cooking sounds, gentle simmering, quiet apartment

initial_prompt: Generate a long, wandering evening kitchen conversation between two partners. One is a natural storyteller who processes his day aloud; the other cooks and listens. Topics drift; some threads come back, some don't. No assistant is involved — this is purely human.

user1.name: Terrell
user1.tts_prompt: Rich and warm baritone, expressive storytelling rhythm

user2.name: Camille
user2.tts_prompt: Clear and bright, slight Québécois quality, warm but precise

variations.context: Weeknight dinner — Terrell talks about his day while Camille cooks, no assistant

setting.mood: Warm and easy. Both comfortable. No pressure to go anywhere in particular.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Couple who've learned each other's rhythms: he narrates, she listens and cooks
setting.background: Camille started dinner when she got home; Terrell arrived later and settled at the counter
setting.conversation_style: Wandering and real. Long Terrell stories, minimal Camille responses that land precisely. Topics drop and resurface or don't. Comfortable silence.

scenario_template.topic: Terrell arrives, notes what's being cooked, settles in
scenario_template.note: Brief physical settling. Comments about the food, the day in general. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Terrell tells a story from his day — a student interaction, a class discussion, something in the hall
scenario_template.mood: Animated and warm from Terrell, attentive from Camille
scenario_template.note: The story has a clear moment but wanders a bit before finding it. Camille asks one precise question. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Camille pauses to do something in the kitchen — the thread drops naturally
scenario_template.note: Physical kitchen activity breaks the rhythm. Brief comments about the food. The story is not resumed immediately. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: A new topic surfaces — unrelated to the first
scenario_template.note: Different subject. Camille follows it. The first story is dropped entirely — that's realistic. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Terrell half-remembers something — a name, a quote, a fact — and trails off
scenario_template.note: He can't retrieve it. Camille doesn't know either. They accept the gap and move on — no Sigma to ask. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: A quieter patch — less talking, more being
scenario_template.note: Brief observations. Kitchen sounds. No need to fill the space. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Camille mentions something from her own day
scenario_template.note: Camille doesn't talk about herself often. When she does, Terrell listens — that's his strength. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

The food marks the end. Brief, genuine. Maybe a callback to something earlier. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

user1.name: Terrell
user1.role: History teacher who processes his day aloud. Warm storyteller whose stories wander. Good listener when not talking. Trails off mid-sentence when he can't remember something.

user2.name: Camille
user2.role: Trained chef, now product manager. Cooks quietly and competently. Listens more than she speaks. When she does respond, it's precise. Dry humor, rarely deployed.
